title: Warranty Coverage Glazing Option Decision Table for Sealed Unit Replacement
content:
**Rule.** For a prorated sealed glass replacement under Warranty Coverage, a glazing upgrade is added to each sealed unit according to the change orders on the Window Replacement Contracts record of the window contract the registration covers. When the window contract carries **laminated glass** change orders covering every opening, each sealed unit adds the laminated unit add-on of **70.00**; when it carries **grilles-between-glass** change orders covering every opening and laminated glass on fewer than every opening, each unit adds the grilles unit add-on of **30.00**; otherwise there is no glazing upgrade. Change orders covering only some openings never count, because the replaced units cannot be told apart.

"Covering every opening" means the openings affected by the change orders of that kind add up to at least the number of openings on the contract.

## Decision table

| Laminated glass covers every opening | Grilles-between-glass covers every opening | Glazing upgrade per sealed unit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 70.00 |
| yes | no | 70.00 |
| no | yes | 30.00 |
| no | no | none |

## Cases (hypothetical 8-opening window contract)

- Laminated glass change orders for all 8 openings: 70.00 per unit.
- Grilles-between-glass for all 8 openings and laminated glass for 3: 30.00 per unit.
- Laminated glass for 5 openings only, no grilles: no glazing upgrade.
- A registration covering a door contract: no window contract change orders, so no glazing upgrade.
